ran: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL set to the empty string on Opus 5.5: in the shell alone (z1), in the shell with a project effortLevel high (z2), in a User settings env block with a project effortLevel high (z3), /effort status for z2's layout (z4), the same layout with no variable as the control (z5), and in the shell with an agent whose frontmatter sets effort high (z6).
result: An empty CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL counted as not set, from the shell or an env block. Alone, Opus 5.5 sent its default, medium. With a project effortLevel high, high was sent, the same as the control, and /effort status printed high. The agent with effort high in its frontmatter sent high. This differs from the value unset, which sends no effort level (experiments/2026-10-29-effort-auto.json).
